title: Data Analysis and Pattern Recognition
description: Statistical data analysis and random processes, ergodicity and stationarity, Bayesian decisions procedures, feature extraction and selection, parametric and non-parametric pattern classification and clustering techniques. Applications to big data, data science, and computer security problems. Students are required to complete a project.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECE 535, ECE 485, ELEC 485, ELEC 535.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
